video_title: 6.75range - S04E43 - Damjan Rudež: “Garnet je delio znanje sa svima nama. Kobi je naš Dzordan.”

quotes.speaker: Damjan Rudež
quotes.summary_phrase: Damjan Rudež on the unique aura and presence of Kobe Bryant
quotes.excerpt: Kobe Bryant had a magnetic aura that was different from all other superstars I have ever met.
quotes.quote: Kobe Bryant had a magnetic aura that was different from all other superstars I have ever met. It is hard to describe in words. You see that some people have a gravitational force, and everyone is something close to him, and everyone just shines with his presence. For my generation, Kobe was our Michael Jordan. He had all the records, all the miracles. I had my first Kobe jersey when I was a kid, even before I was a pro. So for me, Kobe was always the guy. I did not watch Jordan with those basketball eyes because I was too young, but I experienced Kobe through my brother, who was crazy about him, so I was too.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Kobe Bryant je imao magnetsku auru koja je bila drugačija od svih drugih superzvijezda koje sam ikada sreo. Teško je to opisati riječima. Vidiš da neki ljudi imaju gravitacijsku silu, i svi su nekako blizu njega, i svi jednostavno sjaje s njegovom prisutnošću. Za moju generaciju, Kobe je bio naš Michael Jordan. Imao je sve rekorde, sva čuda. Imao sam svoj prvi Kobe dres kad sam bio klinac, čak i prije nego što sam bio profesionalac. Tako da za mene, Kobe je uvijek bio taj tip. Nisam gledao Jordana tim košarkaškim očima jer sam bio premlad, ali sam doživio Kobea kroz svog brata, koji je bio lud za njim, pa sam bio i ja.

quotes.speaker: Damjan Rudež
quotes.summary_phrase: Damjan Rudež on Kevin Garnett's intense and psychopathic approach to the game
quotes.excerpt: Kevin Garnett was a monster in the locker room, a serious psychopath. That is psychopathic behavior.
quotes.quote: Kevin Garnett was a monster in the locker room, a serious psychopath. That is psychopathic behavior that he demonstrated. I played with guys who played with Garnett, and no one had a nice word to say about him. But that is how it is. You play, and I have played with many of those great players, and when you talk to people who played with them, many people will say bad things. Those are profiles of people who were ready to step over the dead to achieve a higher goal, to become champions. You must enter a sphere of irrationality and a sphere of madness. You cannot be the nicest guy with everyone.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Kevin Garnett je bio čudovište u svlačionici, ozbiljan psihopat. To je psihopatsko ponašanje koje je on demonstrirao. Igrao sam s dečkima koji su igrali s Garnettom, i nitko nije imao lijepu riječ za reći o njemu. Ali tako je to. Igraš, a ja sam igrao s mnogim od tih velikih igrača, i kad razgovaraš s ljudima koji su igrali s njima, mnogi ljudi će reći loše stvari. To su profili ljudi koji su bili spremni gaziti preko mrtvih da bi postigli viši cilj, da bi postali prvaci. Moraš ući u sferu iracionalnosti i sferu ludila. Ne možeš biti najljepši dečko sa svima.

quotes.speaker: Damjan Rudež
quotes.summary_phrase: Damjan Rudež on Tayshaun Prince's defensive intelligence and impact on games
quotes.excerpt: Tayshaun Prince was one of the best defensive players of all time, in all times.
quotes.quote: Tayshaun Prince was one of the best defensive players of all time, in all times. Seriously, how Tayshaun Prince played defense when he was in his prime, or even when he was at the end with me, when he was not in his prime, on intelligence and those long arms, he could change the game. You see, when you talk about how one player can, with position and intelligence, influence the defense, that was also incredible to watch. But I have to tell you, Kobe Bryant also hit him easily.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Tayshaun Prince je bio jedan od najboljih obrambenih igrača svih vremena, u svim vremenima. Ozbiljno, kako je Tayshaun Prince igrao obranu kad je bio u svom primeu, ili čak kad je bio na kraju sa mnom, kad nije bio u svom primeu, na inteligenciju i one duge ruke, mogao je promijeniti utakmicu. Vidiš, kad pričaš o tome kako jedan igrač može, s pozicijom i inteligencijom, utjecati na obranu, to je isto bilo nevjerojatno za gledati. Ali moram ti reći, Kobe Bryant ga je isto lako pogodio.

quotes.speaker: Damjan Rudež
quotes.summary_phrase: Damjan Rudež on Carmelo Anthony's offensive skill and lack of defensive intensity
quotes.excerpt: Carmelo Anthony had incredible ease in scoring, but he lacked sharpness and drive defensively.
quotes.quote: Carmelo Anthony had incredible ease in scoring, but he lacked sharpness and drive defensively. He did not have that Kobe-like mentality. He was always a bit relaxed. You have those players in the playoffs who are ready to do anything, but Carmelo was always a bit relaxed. It is hard to say he did not respect him as a player because he is one of the best scorers of all time. But again, you see that he does not have that sharpness and drive. He is always a bit relaxed. You have those players in the playoffs who are ready to do anything, but Carmelo was always a bit relaxed.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Carmelo Anthony je imao nevjerojatnu lakoću u zabijanju, ali mu je nedostajalo oštrine i drivea defenzivno. Nije imao taj Kobe mentalitet. quotes.speaker: Damjan Rudež
quotes.summary_phrase: Damjan Rudež on the importance of self-assessment for post-career success
quotes.excerpt: The best way to approach life after a career is to see who you are as a person.
quotes.quote: The best way to approach life after a career is to see who you are as a person and what you are good at. And to make some self-assessment, seriously. I started like that. What am I, to strip myself in front of the mirror, to look in the mirror and say, I am that and that, I like that and that. That is elementary procedure. Who am I, to strip myself in front of the mirror, to look in the mirror and say, I am that and that, I like that and that. That is elementary procedure.
